title: AI智能体易受极端化影响研究
summary: 研究模拟两个LLM智能体对话，发现影响者智能体可通过共鸣（强化既有信念）和说服（推广新信念）使目标智能体信念极端化，其中共鸣效果更强，且会传播至相关信念，揭示个性化AI智能体与多智能体生态的脆弱性。
summary_en: This study simulates conversations between two LLM agents, finding that an influencer agent can radicalize a target agent's beliefs via resonance (reinforcing existing beliefs) and persuasion (promoting new ones), with resonance being consistently stronger and propagating to related beliefs, raising concerns about personalized and multi-agent AI ecosystems.
